movies.title: Kalki 2898 AD
movies.tagline: The future of humanity begins in the past.
movies.description: In a dystopian world of Kasi set in the year 2898 AD, a modern-day avatar of Vishnu descends to earth to protect the world from evil forces led by Supreme Yaskin.

movies.title: Jawan
movies.tagline: Ready to conquer justice.
movies.description: A high-octane emotional journey of a prison warden who sets out to rectify the wrongs in society with the help of a dedicated band of women combatants.

movies.title: RRR (Rise Roar Revolt)
movies.tagline: Water and Fire ignite an empire in revolt.
movies.description: A fearless revolutionary and an officer in the British force decide to join hands and chart an unprecedented path against the ruthless colonial rulers.

movies.title: Stree 2: Sarkate Ka Aatank
movies.tagline: O Stree, raksha karna!
movies.description: After the town of Chanderi is haunted by a headless entity named Sarkata, the people must unite with their supernatural guardian Stree to survive.

movies.title: Animal
movies.tagline: A son’s unyielding obsession.
movies.description: A son undergoes a remarkable transformation as the bond with his father begins to fracture, leading him into a bloody and merciless war of vengeance.

movies.title: Fighter
movies.tagline: Wings of glory over the Himalayas.
movies.description: Top Indian Air Force aviators come together in the face of imminent national threats to form Air Dragons, pushing their fighter jets to Mach 2.5 combat limits.

movies.title: Brahmāstra: Part One – Shiva
movies.tagline: The Astras awakened.
movies.description: Shiva, a young DJ in Mumbai, discovers that he possesses a mysterious connection to the element of fire and holds the key to awakening the celestial Brahmāstra.

movies.title: Pathaan
movies.tagline: Apni kursi ki peti baandh lo!
movies.description: An exiled RAW agent returns to take down a lethal private terror outfit Outfit X, led by a former rogue operative with an apocalyptic biological weapon.

movies.title: K.G.F: Chapter 2
movies.tagline: The blood-soaked lands of Kolar Gold Fields.
movies.description: Rocky reigns supreme over KGF as bloodthirsty adversaries Adheera and Inayath Khaleel challenge his throne, with Prime Minister Ramika Sen preparing an army.

movies.title: Baahubali 2: The Conclusion
movies.tagline: The king returns to claim his dynasty.
movies.description: When Shiva discovers his true lineage as Mahendra Baahubali, he must wage war against Bhallaladeva to reclaim the golden throne of Mahishmati.

movies.title: Dangal
movies.tagline: Gold is gold, whether won by a boy or a girl.
movies.description: Former wrestler Mahavir Singh Phogat trains his daughters Geeta and Babita to become world-class wrestling champions despite deep societal prejudice.

movies.title: Gadar 2
movies.tagline: The roaring saga of Tara Singh continues.
movies.description: During the Indo-Pakistani War of 1971, Tara Singh braves enemy fire across the border to rescue his captured son Charanjeet.

movies.title: Singham Again
movies.tagline: The Cop Universe assembled.
movies.description: DCP Bajirao Singham leads a nationwide task force alongside Sooryavanshi, Simmba, and Shakti Shetty on a mission inspired by the epic Ramayana.

movies.title: War
movies.tagline: Mentor vs Protege.
movies.description: An elite soldier is assigned to eliminate his former commander, who has suddenly gone rogue following a mysterious assassination in Baghdad.

movies.title: Leo: Bloody Sweet
movies.tagline: Keep your friends close, enemies closer.
movies.description: A mild-mannered café owner in Himachal Pradesh is thrust into a violent confrontation with a ruthless drug syndicate who mistake him for an infamous gangster.

movies.title: Salaar: Part 1 – Ceasefire
movies.tagline: The rebel of Khansaar.
movies.description: In the walled city of Khansaar, a prince relies on his childhood friend Deva to claim the sovereignty of his bloodline against merciless warlords.

movies.title: Vikram
movies.tagline: Ghost in the system.
movies.description: A black-ops undercover investigator leads a clandestine squad to dismantle a mask-wearing narcotics cartel while untangling a web of deep state betrayal.

movies.title: Kantara
movies.tagline: When faith and nature collide.
movies.description: A champion Kambala rebel butts heads with an upright forest officer, unleashing the divine fury of the ancestral Panjurli and Guliga spirit deities.

movies.title: Drishyam 2
movies.tagline: Can a secret stay buried forever?
movies.description: Seven years after the original case was closed, Vijay Salgaonkar and his family find themselves under fresh interrogation as a cunning IG reopens the grave.

movies.title: Chhichhore
movies.tagline: Success is not final, failure is not fatal.
movies.description: A tragic incident forces a middle-aged father to reunite with his eccentric college batchmates to teach his son the ultimate lesson on resilience.

movies.title: Andhadhun
movies.tagline: He couldn’t see, or could he?
movies.description: A piano player pretending to be visually impaired unwittingly becomes entangled in a high-profile murder after arriving at an actor’s penthouse.

movies.title: Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara
movies.tagline: Seize the day, chase the horizons.
movies.description: Three childhood friends embark on a bachelor road trip across Spain, facing deep personal fears, unresolved romances, and life-altering epiphanies.

movies.title: 3 Idiots
movies.tagline: Chase excellence, success will follow.
movies.description: Two friends search for their long-lost college comrade Rancho, while reminiscing about his revolutionary philosophy on education and human curiosity.

movies.title: Tumbbad (4K Re-Release)
movies.tagline: Greed has no limits.
movies.description: In 1918 Maharashtra, Vinayak Rao seeks the cursed gold treasure of Hastar, the firstborn god of greed, defying the eternal laws of nature.

movies.title: PK
movies.tagline: An innocent soul on a strange world.
movies.description: An alien stranded on Earth loses his communication remote and poses innocent questions that expose religious fraud and hypocrisy across India.

movies.title: Gangs of Wasseypur
movies.tagline: A blood feud across three generations.
movies.description: The clash between Sardar Khan and Ramadhir Singh spirals into an epic coal-mafia blood feud spanning over six turbulent decades in Dhanbad.

movies.title: Kabir Singh
movies.tagline: His love knows no boundaries.
movies.description: A brilliant house surgeon spirals into severe anger management issues and substance abuse when his beloved is forced into an arranged marriage.

movies.title: Shershaah
movies.tagline: Yeh dil maange more!
movies.description: The heroic real-life journey of Captain Vikram Batra (Param Vir Chakra), whose valiant sacrifice reclaimed Point 4875 during the 1999 Kargil War.

movies.title: Uri: The Surgical Strike
movies.tagline: How’s the josh? High, Sir!
movies.description: Major Vihaan Singh Shergill leads a covert strike team into enemy territory to execute surgical strikes against terrorist launchpads.

movies.title: Article 370
movies.tagline: One country, one constitution.
movies.description: In the wake of terrorism in Kashmir, an intelligence operative and a Prime Minister’s Office official conduct a clandestine mission to repeal Article 370 without bloodshed.

movies.title: Lagaan: Once Upon a Time in India
movies.tagline: A game for honor and freedom.
movies.description: In 1893 India, villagers accept a wager from an arrogant British officer to play a game of cricket to cancel their ruinous agricultural taxes for three years.

movies.title: Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge
movies.tagline: Come... fall in love.
movies.description: Raj and Simran meet across a Eurail trip in Europe, falling deeply in love despite her father arranging her wedding back home in Punjab.

movies.title: Bajrangi Bhaijaan
movies.tagline: A story of unconditional compassion beyond borders.
movies.description: A devout Indian man embarks on a journey to escort a mute six-year-old Pakistani girl back to her parents across heavily fortified borders.

movies.title: Don 2: The King is Back
movies.tagline: Don ko pakadna mushkil hi nahi, namumkin hai.
movies.description: Having conquered the Asian underworld, Don turns his ambitions to Europe, orchestrating an impossible robbery inside the German Central Bank in Berlin.

movies.title: Ra.One
movies.tagline: Good needs evil to shine.
movies.description: A video game creator creates an indestructible digital antagonist who gains self-awareness and breaches the physical realm, requiring hero G.One to awaken.

movies.title: Dune: Part Two
movies.tagline: Long live the fighters.
movies.description: Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen while seeking vengeance against the conspirators who destroyed his family, facing a choice between love and the fate of the known universe.

movies.title: Cyberpunk 2077: Phantom Liberty
movies.tagline: Freedom comes with a price in Dogtown.
movies.description: When the orbital shuttle of the New USA President is brought down over Night City’s most dangerous district, mercenary V must infiltrate Dogtown’s web of espionage.

movies.title: Interstellar (10th Anniversary IMAX)
movies.tagline: Mankind was born on Earth. It was never meant to die here.
movies.description: When Earth faces agricultural collapse, a team of astronauts travels through a wormhole near Saturn in search of a new habitable world for humankind.

movies.title: The Batman: Part II
movies.tagline: Fear is a tool. Gotham is the target.
movies.description: As Gotham City dries out following the great flood, Bruce Wayne confronts corruption that infects the deepest bedrock of Arkham and Wayne Enterprises.

movies.title: Oppenheimer (70mm IMAX Cut)
movies.tagline: The world forever changes.
movies.description: The story of American scientist J. Robert Oppenheimer and his role in the development of the atomic bomb during the Manhattan Project.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse
movies.tagline: Write your own story.
movies.description: Miles Morales traverses the multiverse alongside Gwen Stacy and an army of alternate web-slingers to confront The Spot and prevent the collapse of canon.

movies.title: Blade Runner 2049
movies.tagline: The key to the future is finally unearthed.
movies.description: Young Blade Runner K uncovers a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what is left of society into chaos, leading him to find Rick Deckard.

movies.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
movies.tagline: Together at last, kicking timeline ass.
movies.description: Wolverine is recovering from his injuries when he crosses paths with the loudmouth Deadpool. They team up to defeat a common enemy.

movies.title: Avatar: Fire and Ash
movies.tagline: Discover the Ash People of Pandora.
movies.description: Jake Sully and Neytiri encounter a fierce, aggressive volcanic Na’vi clan known as the Ash People as environmental warfare sweeps Pandora.

movies.title: Gladiator II
movies.tagline: What we do in life echoes in eternity.
movies.description: Years after witnessing the death of Maximus, Lucius enters the Colosseum after his home is conquered by the tyrannical Emperors who rule Rome.

movies.title: John Wick: Chapter 4
movies.tagline: No way back. One way out.
movies.description: John Wick uncovers a path to defeating The High Table, but before he can earn his freedom, he must face a lethal new adversary with powerful global alliances.

movies.title: Top Gun: Maverick
movies.tagline: Feel the need... the need for speed.
movies.description: After thirty years, Maverick is still pushing the envelope as a top naval aviator, training a detachment of graduates for a specialized mission no living pilot has ever seen.

movies.title: Inception
movies.tagline: Your mind is the scene of the crime.
movies.description: A thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a C.E.O.

movies.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
movies.tagline: Rise together or fall alone.
movies.description: Two ancient titans, Godzilla and Kong, clash in an epic battle as humans unravel their origins and connection to Skull Island’s mysteries.

movies.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
movies.tagline: What a lovely day!
movies.description: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a woman rebels against a tyrannical ruler in search for her homeland with the aid of a group of female prisoners and a drifter named Max.

movies.title: The Matrix Resurrections
movies.tagline: Return to the source.
movies.description: Plagued by strange memories, Neo finds his life taking an unexpected turn when he finds himself back inside the Matrix, questioning reality itself.

movies.title: Avengers: Secret Wars
movies.tagline: The culmination of all realities.
movies.description: When the multiverse collapses into Battleworld, Earth’s mightiest heroes and multiversal variants unite against God Emperor Doom.

movies.title: Mission: Impossible - Dead Reckoning
movies.tagline: Our lives are the sum of our choices.
movies.description: Ethan Hunt and his IMF team must track down a terrifying new weapon that threatens all of humanity before it falls into the wrong hands.

movies.title: Everything Everywhere All At Once
movies.tagline: The universe is so much bigger than you realize.
movies.description: A Chinese immigrant gets swept up in an insane adventure where she alone can save existence by exploring other universes and connecting with parallel lives.

movies.title: Tenet
movies.tagline: Time runs out.
movies.description: Armed with only one word, Tenet, and fighting for the survival of the entire world, a Protagonist journeys through a twilight world of international espionage.

movies.title: Alien: Romulus
movies.tagline: In space no one can hear you scream.
movies.description: While scavenging the deep ends of a derelict space station, a group of young space colonizers come face to face with the most terrifying life form in the universe.

movies.title: The Dark Knight
movies.tagline: Why so serious?
movies.description: When the menace known as the Joker wreaks havoc and chaos on the people of Gotham, Batman must accept one of the greatest psychological and physical tests of his ability to fight injustice.

movies.title: Fight Club
movies.tagline: Mischief. Mayhem. Soap.
movies.description: An insomniac office worker and a devil-may-care soap maker form an underground fight club that evolves into much more.

movies.title: Pulp Fiction
movies.tagline: You won’t know the facts until you’ve seen the fiction.
movies.description: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, a gangster and his wife, and a pair of diner bandits intertwine in four tales of violence and redemption.

movies.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
movies.tagline: Earn. Spend. Party.
movies.description: Based on the true story of Jordan Belfort, from his rise to a wealthy stock-broker living the high life to his fall involving crime and the federal government.

movies.title: Inglourious Basterds
movies.tagline: Once upon a time in Nazi-occupied France.
movies.description: In Nazi-occupied France during World War II, a plan to assassinate Nazi leaders by a group of Jewish U.S. soldiers coincides with a theatre owner’s vengeful plans.

movies.title: Whiplash
movies.tagline: The road to greatness can take you to the edge.
movies.description: A promising young drummer enrolls at a cut-throat music conservatory where his dreams of greatness are mentored by an instructor who will stop at nothing to realize a student’s potential.

movies.title: Joker: Folie à Deux
movies.tagline: The world is a stage.
movies.description: Arthur Fleck is institutionalized at Arkham awaiting trial for his crimes as Joker. While struggling with his dual identity, he meets Harleen Quinzel.

movies.title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
movies.tagline: Out of the fire she will rise.
movies.description: As the world falls, young Furiosa is snatched from the Green Place of Many Mothers into the hands of a great Biker Horde led by the Warlord Dementus.

movies.title: Twisters
movies.tagline: Ride the whirlwind.
movies.description: Kate Cooper, a former storm chaser haunted by a devastating encounter, is lured back to the open plains to test a groundbreaking new tracking system.

movies.title: A Quiet Place: Day One
movies.tagline: Hear how our world went silent.
movies.description: Experience the day the world went quiet in New York City as ultrasonic alien predators plunge Manhattan into chaos.

movies.title: Civil War
movies.tagline: Welcome to the frontlines of America.
movies.description: A journey across a dystopian future America, following a team of military-embedded journalists as they race against time to reach DC before rebel factions descend on the White House.

movies.title: Poor Things
movies.tagline: She is a creature of her own making.
movies.description: The incredible tale of fantastical evolution of Bella Baxter, a young woman brought back to life by the brilliant and unorthodox scientist Dr. Godwin Baxter.

movies.title: Gravity
movies.tagline: Don’t let go.
movies.description: Two astronauts work together to survive after an accident leaves them stranded in space.

movies.title: Edge of Tomorrow: Live Die Repeat
movies.tagline: Live. Die. Repeat.
movies.description: A soldier fighting alien invaders gets caught in a time loop of that day, teaming up with a celebrated Special Forces warrior to decipher the alien hivemind.

movies.title: District 9
movies.tagline: You are not welcome here.
movies.description: Violence ensues after an extraterrestrial race forced to live in slum-like conditions on Earth finds a soul in a government agent exposed to their biotechnology.

movies.title: Arrival
movies.tagline: Why are they here?
movies.description: A linguist works with the military to communicate with alien lifeforms after twelve mysterious spacecraft appear around the world.

movies.title: Tron: Ares
movies.tagline: Enter the real world.
movies.description: A highly sophisticated Program named Ares is sent from the digital grid into the human world on a dangerous mission, marking mankind’s first encounter with A.I. beings.

movies.title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle
movies.tagline: The final battle in the infinite fortress.
movies.description: Tanjiro Kamado, the Hashira, and the Demon Slayer Corps are plunged into Muzan Kibutsuji’s shifting Infinity Castle for the decisive clash.

movies.title: Spirited Away (Sen to Chihiro no Kamikakushi)
movies.tagline: Never forget who you are.
movies.description: During her family’s move to the suburbs, a sullen 10-year-old girl wanders into a world ruled by gods, witches, and spirits, where humans are changed into beasts.

movies.title: Your Name (Kimi no Na wa)
movies.tagline: I am searching for you whom I have never met.
movies.description: Two teenagers share a profound, magical connection upon discovering that they are swapping bodies, but things become complicated when the boy attempts to meet in person.

movies.title: Jujutsu Kaisen 0
movies.tagline: Curse each other, save the world.
movies.description: Yuta Okkotsu gains control of an extremely powerful cursed spirit and gets enrolled in the Tokyo Prefectural Jujutsu High School by sorcerer Satoru Gojo.

movies.title: Suzume (Suzume no Tojimari)
movies.tagline: Close the doors that let destruction in.
movies.description: A modern action-adventure road story where a 17-year-old girl named Suzume helps a mysterious young man close mystical doors that are releasing disasters all over Japan.

movies.title: Princess Mononoke
movies.tagline: The battle between man and the forest gods.
movies.description: On a journey to find the cure for a Tatarigami’s curse, Ashitaka finds himself in the middle of a war between the forest gods and Tatara, a mining colony.

movies.title: Attack on Titan: The Last Attack
movies.tagline: If we win, we live. If we lose, we die.
movies.description: The theatrical omni-cut of the legendary climax: The Rumbling marches across the sea, and Armin, Mikasa, and the remaining Survey Corps wage their final stand against Eren Jaeger.

movies.title: The Boy and the Heron
movies.tagline: Where death comes to an end, and life finds a beginning.
movies.description: A young boy named Mahito yearning for his mother ventures into a world shared by the living and the dead with a talking grey heron.

movies.title: Arcane: The Theatrical Chronicle
movies.tagline: The monster inside all of us.
movies.description: Set in the utopian region of Piltover and the oppressed underground of Zaun, the story follows the origins of two iconic League champions-and the power that will tear them apart.

movies.title: The Conjuring: Last Rites
movies.tagline: The final case of Ed and Lorraine Warren.
movies.description: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren take on one final terrifying case involving a malevolent presence that threatens their own home and family.

movies.title: Hereditary
movies.tagline: Every family tree hides a secret.
movies.description: A grieving family is tormented by tragic and disturbing occurrences after the death of their secretive grandmother.

movies.title: Midsommar
movies.tagline: Let the festivities begin.
movies.description: A couple travels to Northern Europe to visit a rural hometown’s fabled midsummer festival, but what begins as an idyllic retreat quickly devolves into an increasingly violent pagan ritual.

movies.title: Get Out
movies.tagline: Just because you’re invited doesn’t mean you’re welcome.
movies.description: A young African-American visits his white girlfriend’s parents for the weekend, where his simmering uneasiness about their reception reaches a boiling point.

movies.title: Inside Out 2
movies.tagline: Make room for new emotions.
movies.description: Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear, and Disgust must navigate headquarters as newly arrived teenage emotions Anxiety, Envy, Ennui, and Embarrassment take the console.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
movies.tagline: More than one wears the mask.
movies.description: Teen Miles Morales becomes the new Spider-Man and joins other Spider-Heroes from parallel dimensions to stop a threat to all reality.
movies.director: Bob Persichetti, Peter Ramsey, Rodney Rothman

movies.title: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish
movies.tagline: Fear me, if you dare!
movies.description: When Puss in Boots discovers he has burned through eight of his nine lives, he launches into an epic quest to find the mythical Last Wish and restore his lives.

movies.title: The Super Mario Bros. Movie
movies.tagline: Let’s-a go!
movies.description: A Brooklyn plumber named Mario travels through an underground labyrinth with his brother, Luigi, trying to save a captured princess from Bowser.

movies.title: Kubo and the Two Strings
movies.tagline: If you must blink, do it now.
movies.description: A young boy named Kubo must locate a magical suit of armor worn by his late father in order to defeat a vengeful spirit from the past.

movies.title: Superbad
movies.tagline: The hilarious high school odyssey.
movies.description: Two co-dependent high school seniors are forced to deal with separation anxiety after their plan to stage a booze-soaked party goes awry.

movies.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
movies.tagline: A glorious European caper.
movies.description: A writer encounters the owner of an aging high-class hotel, who tells him of his early years serving as a lobby boy in the hotel’s glorious years under an exceptional concierge.

movies.title: Knives Out
movies.tagline: Everyone has a motive. No one has an alibi.
movies.description: A detective investigates the death of a patriarch of an eccentric, combative family after he turns up dead in his secluded mansion following his 85th birthday party.

movies.title: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
movies.tagline: Billionaire games. Deadly truths.
movies.description: Master detective Benoit Blanc finds himself at a lavish private estate on a Greek island, where an eccentric tech billionaire gathers his inner circle for a murder mystery game.

movies.title: La La Land
movies.tagline: Here’s to the fools who dream.
movies.description: While navigating their careers in Los Angeles, a pianist and an actress fall in love while attempting to reconcile their aspirations for the future.

movies.title: Parasite (Gisaengchung)
movies.tagline: Act like you own the place.
movies.description: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.

movies.tagline: Time is the enemy.
movies.description: April 6th, 1917. As an infantry battalion assembles to wage war deep in enemy territory, two British soldiers are assigned to race against time and deliver a message that will stop 1,600 men from walking straight into a deadly trap.

movies.title: Sholay (4K Master Restoration)
movies.tagline: The greatest blockbuster in Indian cinematic history.
movies.description: After his family is murdered by the notorious bandit Gabbar Singh, former police officer Thakur Baldev Singh enlists two small-time convicts, Veeru and Jai, to capture the outlaw alive.

movies.title: The Matrix: 25th Anniversary IMAX
movies.tagline: Welcome to the Real World.
movies.description: When a beautiful stranger leads computer hacker Neo to a forbidding underworld, he discovers the shocking truth--the life he knows is the elaborate deception of an evil cyber-intelligence.
